says: Comments in this theme are thin and mostly sit under brand posts: viewers of the Evolus behind-the-scenes clip credit Dr. Ostad for bringing the crew together, and under his own Jeuveau spot they praise his triple board certification and consultation process, with a few saying they will DM or refer friends. The real question comes from run 1: "Is Botox something you should begin to consider in your 20s as 'preventative'?" drew 279 likes. People want a straight answer on age, and the claims show they also fear drooping, dependence and looking frozen.
